dashboard.title: Dashboard Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Welcome back! Here’s what’s happening at your visitor center this week.
dashboard.heroAlt: Track visits, schedule activities and ensure a safe, welcoming environment for the farm’s visitors.
dashboard.openTask: Open the screen for this task

booking.title: Agritourism booking system
booking.bookingsIntro: Bookings are created from the Registration screen (target: Activity booking); this screen records payments and moves them through their lifecycle.
booking.activitiesUnavailable: Activities could not be loaded — editing a booking is unavailable until the list returns.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 150 characters.
errors.emailTooLong: Email must be at most 200 characters.
errors.people: People count must be a whole number of at least 1.

activities.title: Activities
activities.note: Deactivating an activity cancels all its bookings and cannot be undone.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 150 characters.
errors.price: Price must be a number of at least 0.
errors.capacity: Capacity must be a whole number of at least 1.

occupancy.title: Occupancy per activity
occupancy.note: Confirmations are linked to the scheduling module, so a booking can never exceed the slot capacity. Cancelling a booking releases its seats and refunds a recorded payment.

scheduling.title: Farm tour scheduling
scheduling.loadError: Time slots could not be loaded
scheduling.footnote: 2 slots per day · closed on Sundays. Past weeks are read-only. The capacity is set per slot in the form, so a school group can get a dedicated slot. Cancelling a slot also cancels its registrations and bookings.
scheduling.cancelMessage: Cancelling a slot also cancels its registrations and bookings.
scheduling.guidesUnavailable: Guides could not be loaded — the slot will be saved unassigned.
scheduling.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a whole number of at least 1.

feedback.title: Satisfaction survey
feedback.flowText: visitors give a quick rating on-site on the tablet at the wrap-up stop, and the survey link is sent by email after the visit. All responses are collected here.
feedback.visitorsError: Visitors could not be loaded — sending a survey needs a visitor and is unavailable until the list returns.
feedback.tabletNote: Responses collected on the tablet are stored with the ON_SITE origin.
feedback.footnote: Quick ratings are collected on-site, the survey link goes out by email after the visit, and each response can be routed to the team that owns the follow-up.

send.title: Send survey

tablet.name: Your name
tablet.overall: How would you rate your overall visit?

safety.title: Safety briefing tracker
safety.processText: 5–10 min at the meeting point, delivered by the front desk. A confirmed registration creates a pending briefing; proof of delivery is the staff member plus the group leader's signature. Site access is blocked until the briefing is marked as done.
safety.empty: No briefing to track — confirm a registration first.
safety.footnote: Every briefing is timestamped and recorded with the delivering staff. Site access is strictly blocked until the briefing is marked as done.

form.title: Record briefing — {{name}}
form.staffRequired: Who delivered the briefing is required.
form.staffTooLong: Staff member must be at most {{max}} characters.

staff.title: Staff & guides
staff.subtitle: The farm people directory: everyone picked as operator, technician, observer or guide in any module is added and edited here.
staff.footnote: Every module picks its operators, technicians and observers from this list; guides assigned to a time slot need the Guide role. Deactivating a person keeps the record but removes them from every selector.
staff.deactivateMessage: {{name}} keeps their record but is removed from every selector.

form.roleHint: Only guides, reception and managers have a visitor role; leave it empty for other farm workers.
form.fullNameTooLong: Full name must be at most {{max}} characters.
form.emailTooLong: Email must be at most {{max}} characters.
form.phoneTooLong: Phone must be at most {{max}} characters.

education.title: Educational program
education.footnote: Tour stops define the standard visit, ordered by position. Workshops are created as drafts and published once ready; deactivating a workshop keeps its record but removes it from the offer.

events.title: Events
events.footnote: Events bring several visitors or groups together under one occasion. Registrations, safety briefings and feedback stay linked to each visitor's own record, and past events are completed automatically.

participants.note: “Register visitor” opens the Registration screen with this event preselected; the visitor is then registered on the event.

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.footnote: Visitors are created here or from the registration form. Removing a visitor is a hard delete: only visitors without any registrations, feedback or surveys attached can be deleted.

registration.footnote: The registration is the single source of truth: approve / reject / check-in / edit per visitor. A confirmed registration triggers the safety briefing.
